sentence: She _____ the letter yesterday.
explanation_hi: 'Yesterday' past time दर्शाता है; simple past tense चाहिए।
explanation_en: 'Yesterday' signals past time; use simple past tense 'wrote'.

sentence: Neither of the boys _____ present in the class.
explanation_hi: 'Neither of' के साथ singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'Neither of' always takes a singular verb.

sentence: He has been living here _____ 2015.
explanation_hi: Specific point in time (2015) के लिए 'since' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'since' for a specific point in time; 'for' is used for a duration.

sentence: The teacher advised me _____ harder.
explanation_hi: 'Advise' के बाद infinitive (to + verb) आता है।
explanation_en: 'Advise' is followed by infinitive; use 'to study'.

sentence: The news _____ very shocking.
explanation_hi: 'News' uncountable singular noun है; singular verb लेता है।
explanation_en: 'News' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb.

sentence: She is good _____ Mathematics.
explanation_hi: Skills और subjects के लिए 'good at' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'good at' for skills and academic subjects.

sentence: I look forward to _____ you.
explanation_hi: 'Look forward to' में 'to' preposition है; gerund (-ing) आता है।
explanation_en: 'To' in 'look forward to' is a preposition; use gerund after it.

sentence: Hardly had he reached the station _____ the train left.
explanation_hi: 'Hardly...when' सही pair है; 'than' नहीं।
explanation_en: 'Hardly' is paired with 'when', not 'than'.

sentence: She prefers tea _____ coffee.
explanation_hi: 'Prefer' के साथ comparison में 'to' आता है।
explanation_en: 'Prefer' takes 'to' in comparisons, not 'than'.

sentence: The child was punished _____ his mistake.
explanation_hi: 'Punished for' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'punished for'; the preposition is 'for'.

sentence: Each of the students _____ a notebook.
explanation_hi: 'Each of' singular subject है; singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'Each of' always takes a singular verb.

sentence: He prevented me from _____ the room.
explanation_hi: 'Prevent from' के बाद gerund (-ing form) आता है।
explanation_en: Use gerund after 'prevent from'.

sentence: The furniture _____ very expensive.
explanation_hi: 'Furniture' uncountable noun है; singular verb लेता है।
explanation_en: 'Furniture' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

sentence: No sooner did the bell ring _____ the students rushed out.
explanation_hi: 'No sooner...than' सही structure है; 'when' नहीं।
explanation_en: 'No sooner' is paired with 'than', not 'when'.

sentence: He is addicted _____ smoking.
explanation_hi: 'Addicted to' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'addicted to'.

sentence: The police _____ arrested the thief.
explanation_hi: 'Police' plural noun माना जाता है; plural verb लेता है।
explanation_en: 'Police' is treated as plural and takes plural verb.

sentence: He insisted _____ going there.
explanation_hi: 'Insist on + gerund' सही structure है।
explanation_en: Use 'on' after 'insist'; 'insist on + gerund'.

sentence: The train _____ before we reached the station.
explanation_hi: एक past action जो दूसरी से पहले हुई; past perfect चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use past perfect for an action that happened before another past action.

sentence: She is capable _____ solving difficult problems.
explanation_hi: 'Capable of + gerund' सही structure है।
explanation_en: Use 'of' after 'capable'; the correct phrase is 'capable of'.

sentence: One of my friends _____ preparing for UPSC.
explanation_hi: Subject 'one' singular है; singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: The subject is 'one' (singular); use singular verb 'is'.

sentence: The river overflows _____ the rainy season.
explanation_hi: Seasons के साथ 'in' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'in' with seasons.

sentence: The teacher congratulated me _____ my success.
explanation_hi: 'Congratulate on' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'on' after 'congratulate'.

sentence: He has no interest _____ politics.
explanation_hi: 'Interest in' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'in' after 'interest'.

sentence: She as well as her friends _____ present.
explanation_hi: 'As well as' के साथ verb पहले subject (she-singular) के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: Verb agrees with the first subject 'she' (singular); 'as well as' does not affect agreement.

sentence: He accused the man _____ theft.
explanation_hi: 'Accuse of' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'of' after 'accuse'.

sentence: Scarcely had he entered the room _____ everyone stood up.
explanation_hi: 'Scarcely...when' सही structure है।
explanation_en: 'Scarcely' is paired with 'when'.

sentence: The teacher distributed sweets _____ the students.
explanation_hi: दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'among' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'among' for more than two people; 'between' is for exactly two.

sentence: The child is afraid _____ dogs.
explanation_hi: 'Afraid of' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'of' after 'afraid'.

sentence: He _____ to Delhi last week.
explanation_hi: 'Last week' definite past time है; simple past चाहिए।
explanation_en: 'Last week' is a definite past time; use simple past tense.

sentence: Neither Ram nor his friends _____ ready.
explanation_hi: 'Neither...nor' में verb nearest subject (friends-plural) के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject 'friends' (plural).

sentence: She is _____ university student.
explanation_hi: 'University' consonant sound /j/ से शुरू होता है; 'a' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'University' begins with consonant sound /j/; use 'a' not 'an'.

sentence: He returned after _____ hour.
explanation_hi: 'Hour' silent 'H' से शुरू होता है; vowel sound है; 'an' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'Hour' has a silent 'H' and begins with a vowel sound; use 'an'.

sentence: She plays _____ piano very well.
explanation_hi: Musical instruments के पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before musical instruments.

sentence: _____ sun rises in the east.
explanation_hi: Unique objects के पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before unique objects like the sun, the moon.

sentence: He is _____ best player in the team.
explanation_hi: Superlative adjective के पहले 'the' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the' before superlative adjectives.

sentence: She is _____ MA graduate from Delhi University.
explanation_hi: Abbreviation 'MA' vowel sound /em/ से शुरू होता है; 'an' आता है।
explanation_en: Abbreviation 'MA' starts with vowel sound /em/; use 'an'.

sentence: _____ honesty is the best policy.
explanation_hi: Abstract noun general sense में article नहीं लेता।
explanation_en: Abstract nouns used in a general sense do not take an article.

sentence: He is _____ honest officer.
explanation_hi: 'Honest' में 'H' silent है; vowel sound से शुरू होता है; 'an' आता है।
explanation_en: 'Honest' has a silent 'H' and starts with vowel sound; use 'an'.

sentence: You _____ attend the meeting; it is compulsory.
explanation_hi: Compulsory moral obligation के लिए 'should' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'Should' expresses moral obligation or strong recommendation.

sentence: She _____ have informed me earlier.
explanation_hi: Past unfulfilled obligation के लिए 'should have + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: 'Should have' expresses a past obligation that was not fulfilled.

sentence: He _____ speak five languages fluently.
explanation_hi: Ability के लिए 'can' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'can' to express ability.

sentence: You _____ not park here; it is strictly prohibited.
explanation_hi: Strong prohibition के लिए 'must not' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'must not' for strong prohibition.

sentence: It _____ rain today; the sky looks cloudy.
explanation_hi: Possibility के लिए 'might' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'might' to express possibility.

sentence: You _____ to attend the seminar as it is mandatory.
explanation_hi: 'Ought to' moral duty दर्शाता है।
explanation_en: 'Ought to' expresses duty or obligation.

sentence: She _____ rather stay home than go out in the rain.
explanation_hi: 'Would rather' preference दर्शाता है।
explanation_en: Use 'would rather' to express preference.

sentence: I _____ him since we were at school together.
explanation_hi: 'Since' के साथ present perfect tense आता है।
explanation_en: Use present perfect with 'since' for actions starting in the past and continuing now.

sentence: By the time she arrives, I _____ the report.
explanation_hi: 'By the time' future के साथ future perfect चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use future perfect ('will have finished') with 'by the time' for future completion.

sentence: She _____ three novels before she turned thirty.
explanation_hi: Past moment से पहले completed action के लिए past perfect चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use past perfect for an action completed before a specific past time.

sentence: When I _____ home, I will call you.
explanation_hi: Time clause में simple present आता है; 'will' नहीं।
explanation_en: Use simple present (not 'will') in time clauses with 'when'.

sentence: He _____ for the exam since morning.
explanation_hi: 'Since morning' के साथ present perfect continuous चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use present perfect continuous with 'since' for ongoing actions.

sentence: I _____ her two days ago at the market.
explanation_hi: 'Two days ago' definite past time है; simple past चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use simple past with definite past time expressions like 'ago'.

sentence: She said that she _____ tired.
explanation_hi: Past reporting verb के साथ tense back-shift होता है (is → was)।
explanation_en: When the reporting verb is past, shift the tense back (is → was).

sentence: He asked me where _____ going.
explanation_hi: Indirect question में statement word order (subject + verb) आता है।
explanation_en: In indirect speech, use statement word order (I was), not question word order.

sentence: She told me that she _____ come the next day.
explanation_hi: Past reporting verb के साथ 'will' → 'would' बदलता है।
explanation_en: In reported speech with past reporting verb, 'will' becomes 'would'.

sentence: He said that he _____ finished his work.
explanation_hi: Past reporting के साथ present perfect → past perfect बदलता है।
explanation_en: In reported speech, present perfect ('has finished') becomes past perfect ('had finished').

sentence: The teacher told the students _____ their books.
explanation_hi: Reported command में 'told someone to + infinitive' structure आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'told someone to + infinitive' for reported commands.

sentence: The letter _____ by the manager this morning.
explanation_hi: Past passive voice में 'was/were + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Past passive: 'was/were + past participle'.

sentence: The bridge _____ currently by the engineers.
explanation_hi: Present continuous passive में 'is/are being + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Present continuous passive: 'is/are being + past participle'.

sentence: A new hospital _____ in our town next year.
explanation_hi: Future passive में 'will be + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Future passive: 'will be + past participle'.

sentence: The thief _____ by the police last night.
explanation_hi: Definite past time (last night) के साथ simple past passive चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use simple past passive with definite past time expressions.

sentence: The results _____ tomorrow.
explanation_hi: Future passive: 'will be + past participle'।
explanation_en: Future passive: 'will be + past participle'.

sentence: If it _____, we will cancel the match.
explanation_hi: Type 1 conditional में 'if clause' में simple present आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 1 conditional, use simple present in the 'if-clause'.

sentence: If I _____ rich, I would travel the world.
explanation_hi: Type 2 conditional में 'if clause' में simple past (were) आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 2 conditional, use simple past (were) in the 'if-clause'.

sentence: If he had studied harder, he _____ the exam.
explanation_hi: Type 3 conditional में main clause में 'would have + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: In Type 3 conditional, use 'would have + past participle' in the main clause.

sentence: Unless you _____ harder, you will not succeed.
explanation_hi: 'Unless' clause में simple present आता है।
explanation_en: Use simple present in an 'unless' clause.

sentence: I wish I _____ more time to prepare.
explanation_hi: 'Wish' के बाद unreal situation में simple past (had) आता है।
explanation_en: Use simple past after 'wish' for unreal present situations.

sentence: He talks as if he _____ everything.
explanation_hi: 'As if' के साथ unreal condition में simple past आता है।
explanation_en: Use simple past after 'as if' for imaginary situations.

sentence: _____ he was tired, he continued working.
explanation_hi: Contrast clause में 'although' (subordinating conjunction) आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'although' to introduce a contrast clause (not 'but' with 'although').

sentence: He is rich, _____ he is not happy.
explanation_hi: Contrast दिखाने के लिए 'yet' (conjunction) प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: 'Yet' as a conjunction expresses contrast; it is similar to 'but'.

sentence: _____ she tried her best, she could not pass.
explanation_hi: Contrast clause में 'although' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'although' to contrast two clauses.

sentence: He worked hard; _____, he failed the exam.
explanation_hi: Contrast दिखाने के लिए 'however' (conjunctive adverb) आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'however' to show contrast between two independent clauses.

sentence: She is not only intelligent _____ also very hardworking.
explanation_hi: 'Not only...but also' सही pair है।
explanation_en: 'Not only' is always paired with 'but also'.

sentence: _____ he left, the party ended.
explanation_hi: Time clause में 'when' subordinating conjunction आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'when' to introduce a time clause.

sentence: She is _____ of the two sisters.
explanation_hi: दो के बीच तुलना में 'the + comparative' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'the + comparative' when comparing exactly two things.

sentence: He is the _____ student in the class.
explanation_hi: Group में सर्वश्रेष्ठ के लिए superlative degree आती है।
explanation_en: Use superlative degree for the highest degree within a group.

sentence: Iron is _____ than any other metal in daily use.
explanation_hi: Two items (iron और other metals) के बीच comparative degree आती है।
explanation_en: Use comparative degree ('more useful') when comparing two entities.

sentence: This is the _____ day of my life.
explanation_hi: Superlative degree के लिए '-est' form या 'most' आता है।
explanation_en: Use superlative 'happiest' for the highest degree.

sentence: The _____ you work, the better the results.
explanation_hi: 'The + comparative, the + comparative' structure में comparative form आती है।
explanation_en: Use comparative form in 'the...the' parallel structure.

sentence: She sings very _____.
explanation_hi: Verb (sings) को modify करने के लिए adverb (-ly form) चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use adverb 'beautifully' to modify the verb 'sings'.

sentence: I feel _____ about missing the event.
explanation_hi: Linking verb 'feel' के बाद adjective आता है, adverb नहीं।
explanation_en: Use adjective 'bad' after linking verb 'feel', not adverb 'badly'.

sentence: He drives very _____.
explanation_hi: Verb (drives) को modify करने के लिए adverb (-ly form) चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use adverb 'carefully' to modify the verb 'drives'.

sentence: The results were _____.
explanation_hi: Noun (results) को modify करने के लिए adjective चाहिए।
explanation_en: Use adjective 'surprising' to describe the noun 'results'.

sentence: She looked _____ at the broken window.
explanation_hi: 'Looked' यहाँ action verb है; adverb आएगा।
explanation_en: Here 'looked' is an action verb (not a linking verb); use adverb 'sadly'.

sentence: There are _____ students absent today.
explanation_hi: Countable noun (students) के साथ 'few' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'few' with countable nouns; 'little' is for uncountable nouns.

sentence: He has _____ patience for careless mistakes.
explanation_hi: Uncountable noun (patience) के साथ 'little' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'little' with uncountable nouns; 'few' is for countable nouns.

sentence: There is _____ water left in the tank.
explanation_hi: Uncountable noun (water) के साथ 'little' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'little' with uncountable nouns like 'water'.

sentence: _____ students passed the examination this year.
explanation_hi: Countable noun (students) के साथ 'fewer' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'fewer' with countable nouns; 'less' is for uncountable nouns.

sentence: He has _____ time to complete the project.
explanation_hi: Uncountable noun (time) के साथ 'little' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'little' with uncountable 'time'.

sentence: She has _____ friends in the new city.
explanation_hi: Countable noun (friends) के साथ 'few' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'few' with countable 'friends'.

sentence: She is a doctor, _____?
explanation_hi: Positive statement के बाद negative tag आता है; subject 'she' match होना चाहिए।
explanation_en: Positive statement takes negative tag; pronoun must match the subject.

sentence: He cannot swim, _____?
explanation_hi: Negative statement के बाद positive tag आता है।
explanation_en: Negative statement takes a positive tag.

sentence: Let us go for a walk, _____?
explanation_hi: 'Let us' (suggestion) के साथ 'shall we?' tag आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'shall we?' as the tag for suggestions starting with 'let us'.

sentence: Nobody called while I was away, _____?
explanation_hi: Negative indefinite pronoun (nobody) के साथ plural tag 'they' आता है।
explanation_en: Use plural 'they' in the tag when the subject is 'nobody'.

sentence: He used to live here, _____?
explanation_hi: 'Used to' के साथ question tag 'didn't he?' आता है।
explanation_en: Use 'didn't he?' as the question tag for 'used to' structures.

sentence: She likes singing, dancing and _____.
explanation_hi: Parallel structure में सभी elements same form में होने चाहिए (gerunds)।
explanation_en: Maintain parallel structure; use gerund 'reading' to match 'singing' and 'dancing'.

sentence: He made me _____ for two hours.
explanation_hi: Causative verb 'make' के बाद bare infinitive (to के बिना) आता है।
explanation_en: Use bare infinitive (without 'to') after causative 'make'.

sentence: The teacher let the students _____ early.
explanation_hi: Causative verb 'let' के बाद bare infinitive आता है।
explanation_en: Use bare infinitive after causative 'let'.

sentence: She had her hair _____ at the salon.
explanation_hi: Causative 'have' structure में 'have + object + past participle' आता है।
explanation_en: Use past participle in causative 'have + object + past participle'.

sentence: The scientist made a remarkable _____ that changed medicine.
explanation_hi: 'Discovery' = खोज (पहले से मौजूद चीज़ ढूँढना); 'invention' = आविष्कार (नई चीज़ बनाना)।
explanation_en: 'Discovery' means finding something that already existed; 'invention' means creating something new.

sentence: He was _____ from the competition for breaking the rules.
explanation_hi: Competition से हटाने के लिए 'disqualified' सही शब्द है।
explanation_en: 'Disqualified' means officially removed from a competition for rule violation.

sentence: The minister's speech was full of _____ remarks about his opponents.
explanation_hi: 'Derogatory' = अपमानजनक; negative remarks के लिए सही है।
explanation_en: 'Derogatory' means showing a disrespectful attitude; it is the correct word for negative remarks.

sentence: The new policy will _____ economic growth in the country.
explanation_hi: 'Accelerate' = गति देना; growth बढ़ाने के लिए सही है।
explanation_en: 'Accelerate' means to speed up or promote; correct for boosting economic growth.

sentence: Her _____ attitude towards critics impressed everyone.
explanation_hi: 'Magnanimous' = उदार; critics के प्रति उदार रवैया।
explanation_en: 'Magnanimous' means generous and forgiving, especially towards rivals.

sentence: He is suffering _____ a severe cold.
explanation_hi: 'Suffer from' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: The correct phrase is 'suffer from' for illness.

sentence: The manager is responsible _____ all operations.
explanation_hi: 'Responsible for' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'for' after 'responsible'.

sentence: She is devoted _____ her work.
explanation_hi: 'Devoted to' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'to' after 'devoted'.

sentence: He is superior _____ all his colleagues in writing.
explanation_hi: Latin-origin 'superior' के साथ 'to' आता है।
explanation_en: Latin-origin comparatives take 'to', not 'than'.

sentence: The officer complied _____ all the regulations.
explanation_hi: 'Comply with' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'with' after 'comply'.

sentence: She congratulated him _____ winning the prize.
explanation_hi: 'Congratulate on' सही phrase है।
explanation_en: Use 'on' after 'congratulate'.

sentence: He has been absent _____ last Monday.
explanation_hi: Specific point in time के लिए 'since' प्रयोग होता है।
explanation_en: Use 'since' for a specific point in time.

sentence: She apologized _____ me for the delay.
explanation_hi: 'Apologize to someone' सही structure है।
explanation_en: Use 'to' after 'apologize'; 'apologize to someone for something'.

sentence: A number of students _____ absent today.
explanation_hi: 'A number of' plural माना जाता है; plural verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'A number of' is treated as plural and takes a plural verb.

sentence: The number of accidents _____ decreased this year.
explanation_hi: 'The number of' singular माना जाता है; singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'The number of' is treated as singular and takes a singular verb.

sentence: Mathematics as well as Physics _____ difficult subjects.
explanation_hi: 'As well as' के साथ verb पहले subject (Mathematics-singular) के अनुसार आती है।
explanation_en: Verb agrees with the first subject; 'Mathematics' is singular.

sentence: The committee _____ divided on the issue.
explanation_hi: एक unit के रूप में collective noun singular verb लेता है।
explanation_en: When a collective noun acts as a unit, use a singular verb.

sentence: Five thousand rupees _____ a large amount for the family.
explanation_hi: Sum of money singular माना जाता है।
explanation_en: A sum of money is treated as singular.

sentence: Either of the two candidates _____ eligible.
explanation_hi: 'Either of' singular subject है; singular verb आती है।
explanation_en: 'Either of' always takes a singular verb.

sentence: Please _____ the letter carefully.
explanation_hi: 'Revert' में already वापस आने का अर्थ है; 'back' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Revert' already means to go back; 'back' is redundant.

sentence: I _____ know anything about it.
explanation_hi: Double negative से बचना चाहिए।
explanation_en: Avoid double negatives; 'do not know anything' is correct.

sentence: He is absolutely _____.
explanation_hi: 'Unique' absolute adjective है; इसे modify नहीं किया जा सकता।
explanation_en: 'Unique' is an absolute adjective and cannot be graded or modified.

sentence: She repeated _____ the same mistake.
explanation_hi: 'Repeat' में already once more का अर्थ है; 'again' अनावश्यक है।
explanation_en: 'Repeat' already implies doing something again; 'again' is redundant.
